districts.name: Harbor / Wharf District
districts.purpose: Working edge where arrival, trade, cargo, sailors, and clues physically enter Newport.
districts.player_function: Arrival read, dock clue, visible working harbor life, optional cargo inspection, transition from boat/wharf to town street.
districts.quest_relevance: Arrival harbor beat, dock clue beat, wharf lantern rumor, manifest cargo discrepancy.
districts.landmark: Central cargo landing and warehouse doors aligned to the harborfront road.
districts.dominant_ground_treatment: Weathered planks, wet cobble, mud at cargo edges, water boundary below.

districts.name: Counting House / Clerk District
districts.purpose: Official trade-pressure node where the missing manifest becomes a concrete problem instead of a vague rumor.
districts.player_function: First official objective, records window interaction, clear central route target.
districts.quest_relevance: Missing manifest beat, first objective confirmation, return/report option.
districts.landmark: Counting House frontage and notice board visible from the main avenue.
districts.dominant_ground_treatment: Drier cobble forecourt with paper/posting board and stone threshold.

districts.name: Tavern / Inn Rumor Hub
districts.purpose: Social landmark that converts harbor facts into pre-Revolution whisper network play.
districts.player_function: Memorable west landmark, rumor hub, route choice, safe place to hear named people and motives.
districts.quest_relevance: Tavern whisper beat, two-NPC rumor beat, optional hidden clue route.
districts.landmark: Large Tavern/Inn lot at the west bend of the commercial avenue.
districts.dominant_ground_treatment: Warm cobble threshold, porch/stoop, tavern yard edge, rear gate into service lane.

districts.name: Commercial Avenue
districts.purpose: Readable shop street that ties tavern, counting house, chandlery, market, and island exit into one town spine.
districts.player_function: Human-scale movement corridor with storefronts and repeated orientation anchors.
districts.quest_relevance: Two-NPC rumor, market-route clue, guidepost to island exit.
districts.landmark: Shop row and market shed stepping toward the east exit.
districts.dominant_ground_treatment: Wide cobble/wagon street with worn pedestrian shoulders and storefront stoops.

districts.name: Rear Service Lane
districts.purpose: Back-of-house circulation for deliveries, gossip, hidden clues, and believable town operations.
districts.player_function: Secondary route that teaches the town is not a flat frontage board.
districts.quest_relevance: Hidden rumor/clue route, return/report variant, service-gate overheard lead.
districts.landmark: Rear gate between Tavern/Inn and clerk lodging.
districts.dominant_ground_treatment: Packed dirt, broken cobble, service mud, fence/yard edges.

districts.name: Residential Edge
districts.purpose: Quiet lived-in town edge that gives workers and clerks homes instead of making Newport only storefronts.
districts.player_function: Soft boundary, optional exploration, believable life beyond the quest route.
districts.landmark: Boarding house row above the rear lane.
districts.dominant_ground_treatment: Grass yards, compact footpaths, garden edges, dry dirt.

districts.name: Village-to-Island Exit
districts.purpose: Clear eastward threshold where town composition opens into island exploration.
districts.player_function: Next-step orientation and first-session pull beyond Newport.
districts.quest_relevance: Island lead beat, village exit beat.
districts.landmark: Guidepost and narrowing road beyond the market edge.
districts.dominant_ground_treatment: Cobble-to-dirt transition, shoulder grass, direction sign.

districts.name: Civic / Notice Board Node
districts.purpose: Small official public node that makes the counting-house route readable and gives the journal/objective fiction a place.
districts.player_function: First objective confirmation and route reassurance.
districts.quest_relevance: First objective beat, missing manifest beat, return/report beat.
districts.landmark: Notice board at the central avenue/cross street joint.
districts.dominant_ground_treatment: Worn cobble node, chalk/posted-paper board, compact interaction apron.

districts.name: Hidden Rumor / Clue Route
districts.purpose: Optional service cut-through that lets social stealth and dock knowledge feel spatial rather than menu-driven.
districts.player_function: Discoverable alternate path from tavern/rear lane to wharf clue.
districts.quest_relevance: Optional hidden clue beat and enriched journal state.
districts.landmark: Narrow gate between tavern yard and wharf-side cargo stack.
districts.dominant_ground_treatment: Dirt/cobble service cut-through with clear clearance and no clutter hiding path.
